t: You are on Hertford Street, in Mayfair. It runs from a junction with Park Lane and Old Park Lane at its western end to Curzon Street at its north-east end. Two people with a connection to it are on record. Mary Palmer died here in 1847. Laurence Cadbury, the chocolate and food manufacturer who lived from 1889 to 1982, lived on this street. Beyond those names, the material I have says little more about the street's history.
